title: Accessibility has a statement page of its own at /accessibility (SCAN-1024)
detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-22. The accessibility promise lived in a card on /help and claimed WCAG 2.2 AA flatly. /accessibility is now a dated, canonical, sitemapped page that states an aim, lists three known gaps (search window focus, no pause control for decorative motion, placeholder-only help fields) and names the contact route. LEGAL_LINKS, the site footer and llms.txt point at it; the /help card links to it. The known-gaps list and the date move together. The reply-time promise is deliberately absent: Daniel decides whether to commit to one.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=f=>fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');const bad=[];if(!fs.existsSync('app/accessibility/page.tsx'))bad.push('no accessibility page');else if(!r('app/accessibility/page.tsx').includes('/accessibility'))bad.push('page lacks its canonical');if(!r('lib/nav/legal-links.ts').includes(\"href: '/accessibility'\"))bad.push('legal links still point at the Help card');if(!r('app/sitemap.ts').includes('/accessibility'))bad.push('not in the sitemap');if(bad.length){console.error('SCAN-1024: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when the accessibility statement page, its legal link or its sitemap entry goes missing.
